title: Runtime capability contract (fet3d.editor/1)
description: Value of runtime_compatibility_catalog.capability_contracts[capabilityId]. The capability ID must also be listed in the runtime's capabilities array. A contract that fails this schema is not offered to editors.

events.description: Events the runtime may send for this capability (SCENARIO-02). A learner or playtest event whose type is neither a core event (ExitReached, WrongExit, HazardExposure, Moved) nor declared here for the pinned runtime is rejected with EVENT_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED; a payload that fails the event's schema with EVENT_PAYLOAD_INVALID. Capabilities of one runtime may share a type only with the same payload schema.

payload.description: Absent means the event carries an empty payload.

metric.description: Rubric metric counting the accepted events of this type (BE#183). Absent: the runtime 2.0.x metric for AlarmRaised, ExtinguisherUsed, ExtinguishAttemptLargeFire, ItemWetted, NoseCoveredInSmoke, CheckedDoorHeat, ClosedDoor, UsedElevator, WentBackForBelongings and NpcGuided, otherwise not scored. Capabilities may repeat a metric only for the same type; a metric naming another type, a different metric for one type, or a 2.0.x metric on another type is METRIC_CONFLICT.

actions.description: Unity interaction metadata (Docs 7). The backend checks only id and that event is a core event or declared in events; other fields pass through to Unity.

parameterSchema.description: Closed JSON-Schema subset. Absent means the capability accepts no parameters.
